title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models

primary_resources.read_scope: title, authors, abstract, submission/version history, outbound code/project links
Sections 1–6, Tables 1–8, Appendix A.1–A.8 including algorithm, ablations, protocol and prompt roles
primary_resources.limits: No visual figure/PDF inspection; malformed mixture expression in §3.5 not resolved; no mathematical implementation validation

search.stop_reason: Version/method/limitations established; bounded search found no official implementation

official_code.limits: No code/project link in inspected versioned abstract/manuscript. Search absence is not proof of nonexistence. No repository inspected.

includes: instruction tuning for main Gemma models; Qwen3-4B-Base appendix control
human-chosen broad topic descriptors and synthesis/student/teacher prompt templates
prior_information.scope: §§3.1–3.3; §4.1; Appendix A.4/A.7. Data-free describes post-training inputs, not pretraining history or absence of data.

generated_inputs.producer: EMA teacher or frozen initial model, not student directly

verifier.access: query alone in fresh context, then meaning-preserving paraphrase solved without generated privileged rationale/answer
verifier.authority_limit: self-consistency only; shared systematic errors can survive

consensus_gate.access: query only; G sampled answer rollouts
consensus_gate.rule: discard if all G agree with generated candidate answer
consensus_gate.limit: G and complete rejected-sample compute accounting not specified in inspected text

teacher.identity: EMA weights initialized from same model; beta=0.05 default in MMLU ablation
teacher.training_access: query plus generated rationale/candidate answer and student rollout prefix
teacher.signal: dense next-token distributions; generalized divergence objective; gradient updates
teacher.evaluation: EMA teacher returned/evaluated; at MMLU ablation 47.7 versus student 45.9

ordinary_student.access: query and own prefix; visual setting also image
ordinary_student.withheld: generated privileged rationale/answer during training rollout
ordinary_student.limit: No inference-time external fact oracle; training asymmetry is not reader-source authority

visual_inputs.privileged: self-generated scene caption and/or detected boxes used for derived spatial relations
visual_inputs.verification: answer consistency across image augmentations; horizontal flips excluded as left/right answer-changing
visual_inputs.limit: unlabeled external images mean visual variant is not literally no-input-data; crop answer preservation not independently established

costs.reported_scale: MMLU default ablation: 285 samples/round, 7 rounds; additional 12/20 rounds score lower
costs.unknown: End-to-end GPU-hours, token budget, discarded generations, comparative wall-time/memory and monetary cost not reported in inspected manuscript; cannot infer efficiency from dataset size

ood: Winogrande; GPQA also OOD in mixture experiment
evaluation.baselines: Same synthetic data SFT/GRPO; curated question/answer supervised controls; u-OPSD and R-Zero are author reimplementations
evaluation.protocol: Appendix A.6: non-thinking multiple choice uses closed-option log likelihood; MMLU 5-shot, other MC zero-shot; GSM8K 8-shot CoT. Thinking parses final answer; MATH symbolic equivalence. Authors report zero invalid/parse-failure rate.
evaluation.variance: Gemma E2B repeated over three seeds; reported standard deviations ≤1.2 points; not a full cross-model uncertainty study.

material_results.result: E2B MMLU without thinking 37.5→47.7; with thinking 69.9→71.1
All-three-topic mixture OOD average +0.8 but MATH-500 −4.9; MMLU+HellaSwag MATH-500 −8.5

established_by_paper: Self-consistency is not correctness; consistent errors enter training
not_established: Held-out validation protocol for round/hyperparameter selection separate from reported benchmark
Complete synthesis-vs-evaluation decontamination audit; duplicate removal across training rounds does not establish no overlap with benchmarks
General autonomous self-improvement or sustainable gains across indefinite rounds
leakage_and_limits.interpretation: Benchmark-oriented topic labels and evaluation few-shot exemplars are part of information budget; they do not alone prove leakage. No leakage-free claim warranted.

transfer_status: Proposal only; ordinary-reader source-authority evaluation not run; no training or API calls performed.
